fair: Fair test (S&P 500, 2013 on): the first STRONG week led to a median +10.6% in 13 weeks, against +5.9% on days with the same drop from the high. The STRONG level was picked on that same history, so the gap is not proven.
Arming did no better than any day with the same drop.
4 in 10 arms near the highs saw a further 5%+ drop first (12–17% in Oct 2018, Jan 2022, Jan 2025).
